claims.text: A search panel under the stage takes one search per line, up to four. claims.text: It makes retrieval visible: you see what a query retrieves, how far each result truly is, and whether the neighbourhoods of two queries touch.

honesty_conditions.text: What is lit is exactly what a retrieval over the same vectors with the same measure would return, so the picture can be trusted as a retrieval check.

obligations.source_text: The embed route of viewer serve is off unless asked for with a flag, is refused on a non-loopback bind unless a second flag says so, accepts only POST with a JSON content type from its own origin (Host and Origin checked, no cross-origin headers sent), limits text length and request rate, never logs query text, and never returns the gateway address or the gateway's own error text. With the flag off, viewer serve stays the static-only server it is today and still reads no environment variable. (challenge pass / security: embeddings_tumbler/_static_server.py and cli/_commands/viewer.py; serve can bind non-loopback with a warning, and any web page can send a request to a loopback port.)

obligations.behavior: No file served to a browser and no response of the helper contains the gateway address or key; the key lives only in the helper's process environment.
obligations.source_text: The gateway address and key never reach a page. The core file makes no request; embedding and reranking happen in the host's callback or in the local helper's server process.

obligations.behavior: With no embed callback, picking a point or typing words that match labels or texts produces a search; unmatched words are named; the panel says no text was sent anywhere.
obligations.source_text: Search among the loaded points is supported as well, with no embedding: by picking a point, or by words matched against the labels and texts already in the data file. It works when the host supplies no embed callback.

obligations.behavior: A query is compared only with vectors in the same space; a reduced or shifted file is searched by embedding only with the same change applied to the query, otherwise refused with a plain message.
obligations.source_text: A query vector is only compared with data in the same space. A data file whose reduction is not 'none' (top-k or rotation), or whose producer shifted or scaled the vectors, is searched by embedding only if the file carries what is needed to apply the same change to the query; otherwise embedding search is refused with a plain message and search among loaded points still works. (challenge pass / adjacent systems: docs/data-contract.md reduction and the embeddings-cli export options --rotate and --top-k; a rotated file has the same dimension, so the dimension check alone would pass a wrong comparison.)

obligations.behavior: Without a reranker there is no toggle; with one, results show their move from embedding order and the reranker's name; a labels-only set offers no reranking.
obligations.source_text: A Reranker toggle re-orders the nearest results with a second scorer and says how far each result moved from its embedding order. The toggle appears only when the host supplied a reranker, and the view names the reranker in use.

obligations.seam: Focus mode -> core: the mode interface
obligations.behavior: Focus registers as a fourth mode without editing an existing mode or the data contract, fits its view to the results, and lists each result's text or label as text.
obligations.source_text: A fourth view named Focus: the view is fitted to the results of the search, a ranked list with each result's text sits beside the stage, and clicking a point searches from that point.

obligations.seam: built search -> the two reference pages
obligations.behavior: On comparable data the built views show what docs/specs/reference/tumbler-sky-search.html and tumbler-focus-view.html show (searches, lit and dimmed points, links, shared points, the swing, the collapsed panel, the toggles, the Focus list); every intended difference is listed in the repository and the user signs off the side-by-side comparison before release.
obligations.source_text: Each intended difference between the built search and the two reference pages is listed in the repository, and the user signs off a side-by-side comparison before release. Known ones today: the references place a query from named words and use toy rerankers; the Focus reference draws on a plain canvas, has no multi-search and has an Only results toggle. (challenge pass / the artifact as part of the spec: docs/reference-differences.md is the precedent.)

obligations.behavior: Query text, labels and result texts are inserted as text only; markup in any of them creates no element.
obligations.source_text: Query text and results are inserted as text, never as markup, and are sent nowhere by the viewer; only the host's callback sees the query.

obligations.seam: search -> the space as that search sees it
obligations.behavior: With the option on, ranking, shown distances and the fitted picture all use the same per-dimension scaling by that search's vector; with it off, nothing is scaled; the view states which is in effect.
obligations.source_text: A 'from this search's point of view' option on a search. Distances are measured with each dimension scaled by that search's vector, so lit points and their order reflect the search's context. The picture is fitted to that scaled space, and the view states that distances are measured in the search's context.

obligations.behavior: The lit setting decides which points are lit and how strongly; with brightness by closeness, a nearer point is never dimmer than a farther one for the same search; the panel names the setting in use.
obligations.source_text: Search has a choice of what is lit, including a variable lit power option in which a closer point is lit more strongly.

obligations.behavior: A cell's colour is the mix of the three axis colours weighted by that dimension's squared component on each axis; a dimension that feeds only one axis shows that axis's colour exactly; opacity equals the existing contribution formula.
obligations.source_text: Each cell of the readout strip is coloured by which screen axis its dimension feeds: it mixes three colours according to how much that dimension contributes to the picture's horizontal, vertical and depth axes. Opacity keeps meaning what it means now, the size of the contribution.

obligations.seam: demo data -> person trying the viewer
obligations.behavior: The standalone page opens on real vectors by default and says where they came from, by which model and under which licence; neighbours in it reflect meaning (a real model's distances), and the synthetic set is one explicit choice away.
obligations.source_text: The demo's default data is real: about 1,000 items taken from Wikipedia and embedded by a real model, small enough to ship (about 4 MB). The synthetic set from the reference stays available.

obligations.behavior: N candidates are taken by full-space distance among named points; with a reranker the top X by its scores are the results; without one the first K by distance are; every count is stated.
obligations.source_text: A search takes more candidates and can keep the best of them: the nearest N by embedding are the candidates (3 to 100, 50 by default), and with the reranker on the top X of them are kept (20 by default). With no reranker the results stay at 8 by default and can be raised to 100.
